en.html:
Change direction... one hundred and eighty degrees!
At this point, whether I showed the enemy my back or my backside was not a matter I could entertain.

Away, at full speed—

ja.html:
方向を……一八〇度変える！
　この際、敵に背中を向けようが尻を向けようが気に
してはいられない。

　とにかく一目散に――

Muramasa《...Mido. Right in front of the enemy, this maneuver... aren't we offering a very good target?》
Kageaki"Yes. Just now, that occurred to me also."
